principle: Concrete end-to-end capability examples, each traced unbounded->bounded through the REAL artifacts: the planner classifies the request (check_worked_examples re-runs classify_capability_type, so an example can't drift from the router), it maps to an agentic loop + a waste archetype, and the bounded path is an ordered descent where each step names a tool-plane + registry tools + whether it's deterministic + the LLM's role (none / residual / supervisor). Costs are REPRESENTATIVE (not live). Truth-bearing outputs are Baltor-governed (provenance + freshness + honest-MISSING); the descent itself is Teleon (serves_truth=false).

examples.request: find the latest contact information of Acme Robotics located at Austin, TX

unbounded.approach: frontier LLM with web browsing reasons over each page, reads full pages, re-searches in a loop until it 'feels done' — unbounded steps, whole pages in context

steps.methods: freshness-TTL cache keyed by entity; return prior verified record if still fresh (provenance kept)

steps.step: bounded search for the official source
steps.methods: keyless SearXNG first; cap to top sources (official site, public registry); stop when found
fetch the contact/about page; remove boilerplate
regex for email/phone/URL + NER for org/address; format-validate each
coerce to ContactInfo schema; fields not found -> null (never fabricated)
cheapest-capable model ONLY when >1 candidate entity or low confidence: disambiguate which 'Acme' + confirm freshness; never invent a value

governance.provenance: every field carries its source URL + fetch timestamp
governance.freshness_cdc: freshness TTL + re-verify on read; CDC re-check when the source changes
governance.schema_validation: ContactInfo (name, phones[], emails[], address, website) via Pydantic

examples.request: extract information and put it in this JSON schema from this set of emails and attachments

unbounded.approach: concatenate the whole thread + every attachment and send to a frontier multimodal model, ask it to fill the schema

steps.methods: Python email/MIME parser: drop quoted history, keep the latest message, pull headers (from/to/date/subject), split out attachments
PDF text layer; route scanned/image attachments to the OCR plane (tesseract/paddleocr); prune to relevant pages
detect + extract line-item tables to dataframes
regex/NER for dates, amounts, IDs, emails — every field a parser can get
cheapest-capable LLM ONLY for the ambiguous free-text fields the parsers couldn't fill
enforce the supplied JSON Schema (deterministic floor); missing -> null; reject malformed
audit low-confidence fields; escalate only the flagged ones to a frontier model

governance.provenance: every extracted value points to its email/attachment/page/cell
governance.freshness_cdc: point-in-time documents; re-extract on document update
governance.schema_validation: the caller-supplied JSON Schema, enforced by Pydantic/jsonschema

examples.request: extract the invoice number, vendor, line items and total from these vendor emails into our schema

unbounded.approach: send each full invoice PDF to a frontier model and ask for the fields

steps.methods: MIME split; PDF text layer; OCR plane only for scanned invoices
table detect -> dataframe -> sum check vs stated total
regex for invoice no / dates / currency amounts; vendor via NER
Invoice schema; arithmetic check (line items == total); missing -> null
escalate only invoices where the total fails the arithmetic check or a field is low-confidence

governance.provenance: each field -> source page/cell; arithmetic cross-check recorded
governance.honest_missing: unparseable fields -> null + review ticket, never guessed
governance.schema_validation: Invoice (invoice_number, vendor, line_items[], total) via Pydantic + Pandera
